brief:
Israeli soldier William Shakin died by suicide after developing post-traumatic stress disorder from months of combat service in Gaza, according to Eye on Palestine citing Israeli daily Yedioth Ahronoth. Shakin served with the Golani Brigade's 13th Battalion and immigrated to Israel following the October 7 attacks.

The death reflects mounting mental health challenges among Israeli troops engaged in the conflict. Military personnel who have spent extended periods in combat zones have reported severe psychological symptoms, with some seeking treatment for trauma-related conditions after returning from deployment.

title: Israeli soldier dies by suicide after Gaza combat trauma
